title: Philip and the Ethiopian Official
summary: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 8:26-40 and look for how this passage teaches: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.

tell_it: Philip met a man reading Isaiah and explained the good news about Jesus. The man believed and was baptized.
understand_it: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Philip and the Ethiopian Official reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Scripture matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Philip and the Ethiopian Official shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
teen_explanation: Philip and the Ethiopian Official gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
God sends His people to share good news.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when scripture is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who explained Scripture to the Ethiopian official?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Philip. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Acts 8:35 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Philip and the Ethiopian Official?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Road Bible Talk
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Philip and the Ethiopian Official. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
